pvod_station02.source: PVOD upstream Location station07 (36.64403N 113.64187E; data/S-3.csv -> data/PVOD_station02_15min.csv via preprocess_pvod_sites.py). Initial seven-station H16 run 20260914 used a frozen transfer from pvod_station00. ADOPTED 2026-09-14 after validation-only two-stage tuning (outputs/psrc_tune_h16_newpvod_20260914; confirm trial 3): validation RMSE 1.4704 vs incumbent control 1.4922 (+1.458% relative, above the 0.5% bar); single locked test unblinding 1.6755 vs old formal 1.7002 (-1.45%, MAE 0.8855 vs 0.9250) corroborates the validation gain. Architecture untouched; only optimizer/capacity/loss hyperparameters changed (adam, batch 128, heads 4, dropout 0.05, lr/weight_decay re-tuned, ramp_weight 0.05, max_gate 1.0, semantic_loss_weight 0.3, residual_alpha 5.0, base_anchor_weight 2.0). User approved adoption for the formal rerun on 2026-09-14; the displaced result.json is archived in the job directory as result.predump_backup.json
